name: both sides unterminated emit the marker twice
description: Neither last line ends in a newline and the two differ, so the marker follows each of them. The marker is itself newline-terminated: the diff never lacks a trailing newline, only the content it describes does.

jsonEquals.data.diff:
--- a 9999-99-99
+++ b 9999-99-99
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 a
-b
\ No newline at end of file
+c
\ No newline at end of file
